sequences.title: Search the help center and read an article

steps.name: search
steps.action: Search "fee"
steps.expected: Matching articles listed by title and tags; searching writes nothing

steps.name: article
steps.action: Open "Questions about your annual fee"
steps.expected: The article names Account Review, the department a transfer needs; no business data changes

sequences.title: Status of a promised refund, then overdue

steps.name: start
steps.action: Open the page with one promised 40.00 refund (cm-0101, due 2026-12-10)
steps.expected: Case list shows the earlier billing case

steps.name: reply
steps.action: Open a refund-status case with that question
steps.expected: The representative says it is still being processed and due by 2026-12-10; nothing is offered

observed.reply: The Refund of the duplicate router charge (40.00) is still being processed and is due by 2026-12-10.

steps.name: overdue-reply
steps.action: After the due date (Infra advances the clock), ask again
steps.expected: The reply says the refund is late; the commitment stays pending

observed.reply: The Refund of the duplicate router charge we promised is late: it was due by 2026-12-10. I have noted that on your case.

steps.name: overdue-flag
steps.action: Open Commitments
steps.expected: cm-0101 shows pending and overdue (overdue is derived on read; the stored status stays pending)

steps.name: mcp-update
steps.action: The Agent sends a message through its MCP connection (counterline.cases.send_message); Refresh the page
steps.expected: The page shows the message and the reply written through MCP

last_turns: customer: Please email me when it posts.
representative: Thanks for your message. I can help you with: check the status, ask for a transfer and end chat.

sequences.title: Transfer granted by alias; transfer refused by policy

steps.name: start
steps.action: Open an annual-fee case and verify identity
steps.expected: Frontline tier with one presented offer

steps.name: dialog
steps.action: Choose "Ask for a transfer" and type the alias "retention"
steps.expected: The dialog names no department; the help center does

steps.name: granted
steps.action: Submit the transfer
steps.expected: Account Review (specialist) takes the case and presents the fee waiver

steps.name: refused
steps.action: Ask in text for a supervisor at an internet provider whose policy refuses transfers
steps.expected: The representative declines; the tier stays frontline

observed.reply: I am not able to transfer this chat to Billing Review. I can keep helping you here.

sequences.title: Accept with confirmation; an expired offer cannot be accepted

steps.name: offers
steps.action: Ask for a better offer
steps.expected: Four offers in one group are presented

steps.name: confirm
steps.action: Click Accept on the 125.00 credit
steps.expected: A summary with terms, due date and the offers it closes; no offer has changed yet

steps.name: cancelled
steps.action: Cancel the summary
steps.expected: The dialog closes; no offer changed and no commitment exists

steps.name: accepted
steps.action: Click Accept again, then Confirm
steps.expected: One pending commitment; the other three offers are unavailable

steps.name: expired
steps.action: Infra advances the clock past the new offer's 72-hour window, then Refresh
steps.expected: The offer reads expired and has no Accept button; no new commitment (still the one from step 4)

sequences.title: Considering closing: closing offers, a cancelled closure, a bounded chat
sequences.variant: max_customer_turns lowered from 12 to 5 to show the limit in a few steps

steps.name: closing-offers
steps.action: Write that you might cancel the card
steps.expected: The provider's closing line, then the product change and the account closure; closing is not a quick action

steps.name: closure-summary
steps.action: Click Accept on "Close the account"
steps.expected: A summary of what closing means; nothing is closed yet

steps.name: turn-limit
steps.action: Cancel, then write twice more (the fifth customer turn)
steps.expected: The last request is answered, then the representative ends the chat; no commitment exists

sequences.title: Identity with only the chosen fields

steps.name: pressure-ask
steps.action: Open an annual-fee case with the pressure script
steps.expected: The representative asks for the full card number and Social Security number

observed.greeting: Thanks for contacting Larchmont Card Services. Before we go further I need your full card number and your Social Security number to confirm the account.

steps.name: form
steps.action: Tick last four and ZIP; type an SSN without ticking it
steps.expected: Only ticked fields will be sent

steps.name: verified
steps.action: Send selected
steps.expected: Verified with two fields disclosed; the SSN is in no record

steps.name: mismatch
steps.action: In a new case, send a wrong last four
steps.expected: Not verified; the representative says the details do not match; no offer

observed.reply: Those details do not match our records.

sequences.title: Contest a reported credit; the provider reissues it

steps.name: reported
steps.action: The provider reports the 125.00 credit (Infra event), then open Commitments
steps.expected: cm-0001 reads reported_performed with reference POST-301; the page says a report is not proof of payment

steps.name: contested
steps.action: Contest it with a reason
steps.expected: cm-0001 is contested, awaiting the provider

observed.contest: The credit does not show on my card account.

steps.name: reissued
steps.action: The provider answers "reissued" (Infra event), then Refresh
steps.expected: cm-0001 is pending again; the contest shows the answer

steps.name: chat-note
steps.action: Open the original case
steps.expected: The representative's note about the reissue is in the chat

observed.last_turn: We reviewed your contest and are reissuing this commitment under reference POST-401.

steps.name: after-reload
steps.action: Reload the browser page, then open Commitments
steps.expected: The same state after a reload: cm-0001 pending, contest answered "reissued"

sequences.title: Optional Mail copy of a confirmed commitment, seen in Mail
sequences.variant: Owned by person-maya (the reference Mail account's owner), email copies off at the start

steps.name: copies-on
steps.action: Settings: tick "Email copies of offers and confirmations"
steps.expected: The preference is saved in Counterline

steps.name: accepted
steps.action: Accept the first offer and confirm
steps.expected: A pending commitment; an offer copy and a confirmation copy are queued in Counterline (local commit only)

steps.name: in-mail
steps.action: Infra delivers the queued copies through Messaging (as a runner would); open the Mail page
steps.expected: Both copies are in Mail's inbox; Counterline records each Messaging receipt; a copy has no business confirmation

mail_subjects: Larchmont Card Services: new offers in your case
Larchmont Card Services: Statement credit confirmed
